project.name: Campus SOS
project.purpose: Master specification for generating the complete Campus SOS product documentation package.
project.implementation_status: Generate the specification package first; do not implement the production application yet.

global_rules.if_ambiguous: Document the ambiguity and propose a safe implementation rule without deleting the original requirement.
global_rules.traceability: Every requirement must be mapped to generated documentation.

product_principles: Campus SOS is a campus safety and emergency-response platform, not a generic AI dashboard.
Emergency SOS is the highest-priority workflow for major immediate emergencies.
Report an Incident is for normal/non-immediate campus issues and concerns.
AI classifies and structures the report; deterministic routing rules decide teams and notification audiences.
Campus Administration has visibility into every incident.
Sensitive incidents are not automatically broadcast to students.
Photos are evidence and are available to Campus Administration and all teams assigned to the incident.
Emergency workflows must remain operational when one external service or responder fails.
Frontend and backend are completely separated for maintainability.
Real/demo accounts are created only at the final stage.

emergency_sos.purpose: Major campus emergencies such as serious fire hazards, major accidents, major blocked routes, serious security threats, major fights/quarrels, and other immediate emergencies.
flow: Student may attach up to 2 photos.
Student selects a predefined campus location when useful.
Student places an exact pin on the uploaded static 2D campus map.
Routing engine determines teams and notification audience.
Student receives a live status screen.

report_incident.purpose: Normal campus reports, complaints, concerns, and non-immediate incidents.

location.map_type: Uploaded static 2D college campus map image
location.student: Can tap/click the map to place the exact incident pin.
location.storage: Store normalized relative X/Y coordinates so the pin remains accurate at different screen sizes.
location.explore: Display incident pins on the same campus map.

photos.access: Campus Administration and every team/person assigned to the incident.

ai_duties: provide reasoning/metadata for authorized personnel where appropriate
ai_must_not: decide public disclosure of sensitive cases

notification_rules.logged_in_users: Can receive appropriate campus safety notifications when notifications are enabled.
campus_wide_when_relevant: event requiring students to avoid an area
notification_rules.principle: Notify people who need to act and people who need to know; do not notify people who should not receive the information.
notification_rules.sensitive_cases: Never broadcast sensitive case details to all students by default.

first_aid.rule: Provide only conservative basic first-aid guidance while professional medical help is responding; never diagnose or delay professional care.

student_council.scope: Student grievances, welfare, and configured student-teacher/student-campus concerns.

infrastructure_facilities.scope: Infrastructure, electrical, water, building, maintenance, and facility hazards.

transportation.scope: Road blockage, transport, traffic, parking, vehicle incidents.

it_digital_safety.scope: Cyber incidents, digital harassment, account/security, network/digital safety.

dispatch.mode: Automatically assign a specific available responder and notify the relevant team.

states.Available: On duty and eligible for a new case.

dispatch.example: Dr. Mahika is assigned a medical case, becomes Busy, becomes Available after finishing, and is Offline when off duty.
fallback: If a responder rejects or does not respond within a configured period, try another eligible responder.
If multiple responders are required, assign multiple responders.
If nobody is available, escalate to the relevant team coordinator/administration.
Team-level awareness remains active after individual assignment.

click_actions.Total Incidents: Open all incident statistics/history including active and resolved cases.

user_directory.must_not_be: A directory of every student's phone number.

campus_explore.privacy: Sensitive incidents are sanitized or excluded according to access permissions.

ui_ux.role_rule: Each role has its own purpose-built interface rather than one generic dashboard with random widgets hidden.

audit.timeline: Chronological case history visible to authorized personnel.

structure.contracts: Documented API/data contracts between frontend and backend.

frontend_backend.goal: A second developer should be able to locate UI, API, AI, routing, notifications, dispatch, database, authentication, and audit code without navigating an unstructured monolith.

accounts.current_phase: Build all interfaces and role architecture now.
accounts.temporary_preview: Use development-only role switching/mocking if required to preview each role.
accounts.real_accounts: Create at the end after the user provides final names, teams, contacts, duty statuses, and roles.
accounts.demo_data: Do not seed fake production data during foundational development.

required_output_files: docs/PRD.md
Complete product requirements, scope, personas, workflows, requirements, acceptance criteria.
docs/TECH_STACK.md
Frontend, backend, database, auth, AI, realtime, notification, storage, testing, deployment, observability.
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
Complete system architecture, module boundaries, data flows, security, realtime, AI/routing, dispatch, notification architecture, Mermaid diagrams.
docs/DATABASE_SCHEMA.md
Entities, fields, types, constraints, relationships, indexes, permissions, statuses, incidents, attachments, map coordinates, notifications, assignments, audit.
docs/API_SPECIFICATION.md
All API endpoints, authentication, authorization, requests, responses, validation, errors, pagination, file uploads, realtime events.
docs/UI_UX_SPECIFICATION.md
Complete from-scratch design system and all role-specific screens, navigation, components, responsive/mobile behavior, states and interactions.
docs/AI_ROUTING_SPECIFICATION.md
AI input/output contract, taxonomy, routing matrix, audience matrix, fallback, escalation, multi-team rules, test cases.
docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md
Phased Antigravity build plan, dependencies, milestones, testing gates, integration, UI review, final account phase.
docs/REQUIREMENTS_TRACEABILITY.md
Every requirement ID mapped to exact documentation sections with validation status.
README.md
Master index and instructions for using all generated documentation.
implementation_sequence: Demo accounts and demo data last
final_validation: Every role has a dedicated interface specification.
Emergency SOS confirmation flow is documented.
Live student SOS status is documented.
My Reports has separate Reports and Emergency SOS views.
Static 2D map and exact pinning are documented.
Unknown-person security photo workflow is documented.
AI classification and deterministic routing are documented.
Campus-wide versus restricted notifications are documented.
Admin View Incident exposes the complete student description and case details.
User Directory contains Campus SOS personnel/responders rather than a student phone directory.
Demo accounts are explicitly deferred to the end.
Existing UI is explicitly not reused.
Unnecessary urgency filters are explicitly removed.

zip_output.must_contain: Every required output file plus this JSON source specification.
